title: EpisPackageConsignmentV2
label: LAZADA · API REFERENCE
subtitle: External partner call EPIS to consign FFM + DEL package to get the tracking number and be able to print AWB after consign
html:
Request Address

POST/logistics/epis/packages/consign/v2
RegionBase URL
Vietnamhttps://api.lazada.vn/rest
Singaporehttps://api.lazada.sg/rest
Philippineshttps://api.lazada.com.ph/rest
Malaysiahttps://api.lazada.com.my/rest
Thailandhttps://api.lazada.co.th/rest
